Skills and Qualifications
Business Leadership / Operations:
Eight years as CEO of The Aerospace Corporation. Thirty-seven-year career with The Aerospace Corporation included numerous senior management and executive positions. Established MakingSpace, Inc., a leadership and STEM

Finance:
More than a decade of financial responsibility and experience at The Aerospace Corporation. Audit Committee member at Amgen Inc.
Global Business / International Affairs:
Internationally
recognized for her work in satellite and payload system acquisition, systems engineering, and system simulation. Former CEO of a company that provides space systems expertise to international organizations. Director of companies with international
operations.
Government / Regulatory / Public Policy:
Served on President’s Council of Advisors on Science and Technology and President’s Review of U.S. Human Space Flight Plans Committee. Appointed to the Defense Science Board and the NASA Advisory Council.
Research / Academia:
Research Professor at the University of Southern California’s Viterbi School of Engineering.
Science / Technology / Engineering:
Ph.D. in Industrial and Systems Engineering from the University of
Southern California, Master of Science in both Systems Engineering and Mathematics from the University of Pittsburgh. Thirty-seven-year career in national security space programs. Director at Amgen Inc., a biotechnology company. Fellow of the
American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics.
